headline: Hackers exploit critical Atlassian file-access flaw after public PoC
summary: Atlassian disclosed a critical file-access vulnerability, CVE-2026-21589, affecting self-hosted Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket Data Center products. After a public proof-of-concept was released, hackers began actively exploiting the flaw in unauthenticated attacks.

claims.statement: Atlassian warned of a critical file-access vulnerability (CVE-2026-21589) affecting Data Center products including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket.

sources.quote: Atlassian warns of critical file access flaw in its datacenter products
a critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-21589, that can be exploited for arbitrary file-access in multiple self-hosted Data Center products, including Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket

claims.statement: Hackers are now actively exploiting the flaw in attacks that do not require authentication, following release of a public proof-of-concept.
